content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Cedar Rapids

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria to confirm you meet the education and professional-experience thresholds before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend interactive sessions on your schedule, ask questions in real time, and receive comprehensive instruction in all five PMBOK® process groups—no commute, no classroom constraints.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, create your PMI account and submit your PMP application directly to the Project Management Institute. Pay the associated exam fee and wait for PMI's approval—typically processed within two weeks—before scheduling your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and instructor guidance to reinforce key concepts. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner and sit for the four-hour, 180-question computer-based test when you feel ready.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses and training that count toward PDU requirements, keeping your certification current and competitive.
